b_conclusion: serve advertises ONLY tools — no logging/notifications channel; watch_hit today is strictly pull (watch_events). A push path exists in-protocol (notifications/message, proven in half A) but surfaces to clients as a LOG line, not a structured tool event — so agent-tooling would still need to poll watch_events for the payload. Recommendation: keep pull as the contract; optionally mirror hits as notifications/message for human-facing logs later.
